corpus: mixed human/model final text from earlier sessions
finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base, pooled and donor advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods. Useful uniform advantage is excluded under both, and all primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods, with all model-rival intervals including zero. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, with worse performance only under writer resampling. Raw sums are worse than base and uniform under both methods; raw pooled and donor useful advantage remains unresolved under both, with their intervals including zero. No parity follows.
limits: The first eight-epoch mixed-text seed failed and remains unscored; this is not a completed two-seed comparison. Mixed human/model final documents, sparse histories, transferred rank, fixed donor/global training, shared human units and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, epoch or seed ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict.
